verdict.rationale: The IRS's own pages document online rails for a founder's core transactions: the EIN online assistant, Direct Pay and EFTPS payments, IRIS e-filing of information returns, and mobile-friendly signed forms such as Form 15620. Each rail carries published limits: the EIN tool keeps set operating hours, sessions expire after 15 minutes of inactivity with no save, only one EIN per responsible party per day, and signed online forms require an ID.me-gated Online Account. missing for 10: round-the-clock availability of the EIN rail, save/resume for online sessions, and independent hands-on corroboration that the flows complete end to end.

support.subject: As a founder, the core transaction this service exists for (form, register, apply, file, or pay) can be completed online, per the service's own published pages

citations.quote: This tool is available during the following times (Eastern Time): Mon–Fri: 6:00 a.m. – 1:00 a.m. (next day); Sat: 6:00 a.m. – 9:00 p.m.; Sun: 6:00 p.m. – 12:00 a.m.
It expires after 15 minutes of inactivity, and you'll need to start over.
receives information through two intake channels: IRIS Taxpayer Portal/UI and IRIS Application to Application (A2A)
